rules.day.q: Question. Where does {sym} close at {ts}, measured against its close 24 hours earlier? {n} ranges; the one containing the move wins.
rules.day.betting: Betting opens {open}, while the previous day's pool is still taking bets, and stops {close} — twelve hours before the close, before most of the answer exists.
rules.day.result: Result. There is no exchange close for this token, so the close is the median of one Jupiter quote per minute during the last hour, {range} on {day}; the move is that close ÷ the close 24 hours earlier − 1. The earlier close is not known when betting opens (it forms at {base}) — as a stock pool opens before the previous session has closed. Proposed after {after} with every sampled quote of both days published and their hash on-chain; disputable for {h} h. Fewer than 40 usable quotes on either day (a delisted token, a dead feed) voids the market with a full refund.
rules.day.why: Why this token. Memes are picked every day at {time} for the following pool: the ten Solana tokens with the most 24-hour traded volume whose mint and freeze authorities are gone, with at least $500k of liquidity and a first pool at least 3 days old. Tomorrow's list can differ from today's; an open market always settles.
rules.day.ranges: Ranges are cut at ±{pct}, the token's median absolute daily move over its last 60 days, so "flat" and the two tails started out about equally likely.
rules.day.rangesNoPct: Ranges are cut at ± the token's typical daily move, its median absolute daily move over its last 60 days, so "flat" and the two tails started out about equally likely.
rules.payouts: Payouts are in {tok}: winners get their stake back plus a share of the losing ranges, pushed to wallets automatically. Fee {early}% of winnings until {until}, then {fee}% — never on your stake.
rules.issuerFee: Issuer transfer fee. {iss} charges {fee} on every transfer of {tok}, including into and out of this pool. Your stake counts as what actually arrives in the pool, and a payout lands net of that fee. That fee goes to {iss}, not to SharePot.
rules.close.q: Question. Where does {sym} close at the New York closing bell, {ts}, measured against the previous session's close? Four ranges; the one containing the move wins.
rules.close.closeBell: — the New York opening bell — before any of the answer exists
rules.close.result: Result = total-return move: (official close + any dividend going ex that day) ÷ previous official close − 1, closes on the same share basis across splits. Proposed after {after} with the raw price data and its hash on-chain; disputable for {h} h.
rules.close.divs: Dividends and splits on the token are applied by the issuer to every balance alike (a multiplier), pools included, so every stake keeps its share. A spin-off, a delisting merger or a full-session halt voids the market with a full refund.
rules.close.issuer: Issuer controls. {iss} can pause {tok} transfers; while paused, bets and payouts for this pool wait. xStocks and Backpack tokens also let the issuer move tokens held in any account, these pools included.
rules.close.ranges: Ranges are set near the quartiles of {sym}'s recent daily moves, so each started out roughly equally likely.

title.index: SharePot · bet with your stock tokens
hero.h1: Bet with your stock tokens. Win more shares.
hero.p: Daily pools on where US stocks close. Stake the tokenized stock you already hold — xStocks, Backpack or Ondo — and winners are paid in that same token. Nothing gets sold. The same pools run on pre-IPO tokens (Tessera, PreStocks) and, every day, on the ten most-traded Solana memes.
hero.s1: Pick a rangeBig drop, small drop, small gain or big gain — for today's close vs yesterday's.
hero.s2: Stake sharesBets stop at the opening bell. A drop bet hedges shares you keep; a gain bet adds upside.
hero.s3: Get paid in sharesAfter the official close, winners split the losing pools. Automatic, verifiable on-chain.
foot.pool: SharePot is a parimutuel pool, not an order book: payouts depend on the final pool sizes. Fee 3% of winnings (2% early), never on your stake. Results are disputable for six hours, then paid out automatically.
foot.issuer: Issuer controls. Stock tokens are issued by xStocks (Backed), Backpack Securities and Ondo Global Markets, who can pause transfers of a token; xStocks and Backpack tokens also let the issuer move tokens in any account, these pools included. Tokenized stocks are not offered to US persons.
meta.index: Daily prediction pools on US stocks, staked and paid in tokenized stocks (xStocks, Backpack, Ondo) on Solana.
fc.intro: SharePot runs on Solana devnet. The stock tokens here are mock copies of the real ones — same issuers, same token settings, no real value — so anyone can try the whole flow: stake, wait for the close, get paid.
fc.s1: Switch your wallet to devnet (Phantom: Settings → Developer settings → Testnet mode → Solana Devnet), or use the built-in Test wallet (browser) from the Connect menu.
fc.s2: Press Get test tokens — once per wallet per day.
fc.s3: Pick a market and stake some shares before the opening bell.
